subject: frame model: what-if table (P3 poll / 654-886 / async / preload / encode fix)
body:
Source: gpu/tools/frame_model.py (python3 gpu/tools/frame_model.py prints it; knobs in SCEN_DEFAULTS/PATH). Fit c6jb ui-usb+boot2 (33 windows): gpu_ms = 5.75*fs_job + 3.39*other_job (R2 .99, LOO MAPE 7%); split cost=wait(2.5 assumed)+compute. Encode = commit-create wall = 6.45 ms/draw (draw-only fit R2 .99, LOO 6%, n=4 no-compile windows; strong candidate: per-draw SHA-256 of 593 KB SPIR-V in software). Shapes below are device-observed mean per command (draws/jobs per frame from TEGU_PERF_BATCH). Cells: frame ms serial (fps serial/pipelined). ASSUMPTIONS not device-measured: wait 2.5 ms/job today, 0.02 with P3, compute ~1/clock, preload share 0.5 of fs-job area term, intersect area 0.25, encode fix x0.05.
